en.title: 10 Must-Watch Movies Landing on Prime Video This September
en.summary: Prime Video's September 2026 lineup is stacked, offering everything from blockbuster exclusives to genre-defining classics. It's the perfect time to dive into their ever-expanding library.
en.body:
## 1. Neagley
This thrilling addition to Prime Video's slate promises espionage and high-stakes action, continuing the intense narrative fans have come to expect. Get ready for a pulse-pounding ride that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

## 2. Drawn Together
Expect the unexpected with this animated series that pushes boundaries and delivers a unique brand of humor. It's a refreshingly different take on storytelling that's sure to spark conversation.

## 3. The Love Hypothesis
Romance takes center stage in this highly anticipated series, perfect for anyone looking for a heartwarming and engaging story. Based on the popular novel, it’s set to be a fan favorite.

## 4. Project Hail Mary
Prepare for an interstellar adventure that combines gripping science fiction with genuine heart and humor. Based on Andy Weir's novel, this film is a testament to human ingenuity and the vastness of space.

## 5. War Dogs
Inspired by a wild true story, this film plunges into the chaotic world of international arms dealing. It’s a sharp, darkly comedic look at how two friends from Miami found themselves in over their heads.

## 6. Jack Ryan: Ghost War
Fans of John Krasinski's iconic CIA operative will rejoice with this latest installment. Expect more globe-trotting intrigue and intense action sequences as Jack Ryan faces a new, formidable threat.

## 7. Army of Darkness (1993)
Bruce Campbell's Ash Williams returns in this cult classic that masterfully blends horror, comedy, and fantasy. It’s a quotable, chainsaw-wielding adventure that remains endlessly rewatchable.

## 8. Atomic Blonde (2017)
Charlize Theron delivers a knockout performance as a deadly spy navigating the treacherous streets of Berlin during the Cold War. This stylish action flick boasts incredible fight choreography and a killer soundtrack.

## 9. Blow Out (1981)
Brian De Palma's neo-noir thriller is a masterclass in suspense, featuring John Travolta as a sound recordist who stumbles upon evidence of a political assassination. Its intricate plot and chilling atmosphere make it a must-see for cinephiles.

## 10. A Serious Man (2009)
The Coen Brothers offer a darkly comedic and existential look at the struggles of Larry Gopnik, a physics professor facing a series of misfortunes. It’s a poignant, often bizarre, exploration of faith and fate.
Bottom Line: Prime Video's September slate is a cinematic buffet, serving up everything from fresh exclusives to enduring classics for every kind of movie lover.

content_raw: Prime Video has quickly become one of the strongest all-around streaming libraries for true movie lovers. They have found a mix of brand-new theatrical exclusives to weave into an impressively deep, well-curated back catalog. This month's lineup is a particularly strong argument for that case, pairing two of 2026's biggest theatrical hits with a run of prestige dramas, genre classics and a horror classic that has truly stood the test of time. Whether you are chasing something new or filling in a gap in your movie-watching history, there's a real range here worth carving out time for.
